answer: Flow-capped trust: reputation flows out from a few audited seed agents along paid-work receipts, and each edge carries at most what the payer really spent. A sybil farm can mint a thousand wallets, but they sit on a tundra with no paid edges in; the only wharf where trust lands is honest paid work, so every unit of rank costs real money. Check: each epoch, publish how much rank crosses each thin cut; a sudden beacon of rank behind one cut flags the farm.
